properties.name: TRIAGE 2026-09-07 of dev_storyflow's 2026-09-06 entries (on 0.48.0): nine asks, five already answered on 0.49.0/0.50.0, two root-caused as live defects, three recurrences counted, three praises confirmed
properties.statement:
Peer file lines 7185–7285, one agent, one day (2026-09-06), reflow2 0.48.0 — the reporter READ its version off the export stamp mid-session, so unlike the 2026-08-23 case it could name its build. Triaged under rule:field-feedback-issues-are-root-caused-and-ideas-are-brainstormed with rule 10's tier 1 (search the precedent) on every item.

ALREADY SHIPPED when reported, on a build the reporter did not have (5): add_design_rule exists (0.48.0, they found it themselves) and since 0.50.0 refuses a stated `enforced` with no approver — exactly the misuse they confessed; the promotion pair (Requirement beside its brainstorm Decision) is reported-not-refused since 0.49.0; enum values are published in the tool schema since 0.49.0; `verifies` no longer needs target_type since 0.49.0 and add_verification takes its targets since 0.50.0; add_decision takes status + approver since 0.50.0. The cadence cost again: a build two versions old reports as new what the next two cuts answered.

LIVE DEFECTS, root-caused with a measurement (2): create_node stores `null` as a third property state that readers disagree about (fact:defect-a-null-sent-to-create-node-is-stored-as-a-third-state-between-stated-and-unstated); the batch accept refuses whole for a checksum-less artifact whose only legal disposition is the first baseline (fact:defect-a-batch-accept-refuses-whole-for-an-artifact-whose-only-legal-disposition-is-the-first-baseline).

RECURRENCES COUNTED on their records (3): no `test` artifact_type (#2); the arg-shape misses (#5, four of six answered on current builds); the second-layer guard (#3 — the new instance is the (Capability, Verification) pair, not prescribed).

IDEAS recorded as exploratory Decisions (5): verifies takes a list; enum near-synonyms; a status move with no change since planned says so; a failing check whose findings name a changed file is flagged; prose_currency quotes enough to judge.

CONFIRMED IN THE FIELD (3): prose_currency right three times in a day (fact:prose-currency-caught-three-stale-descriptions-in-one-field-session); the root-cause rule set mid-session 'paid for itself again' — a census that convicted itself and a capability found already true before building; a DesignRule + governed_by(Project → rule) as the home for a process rule 'because every agent reads it'.
